fusions.name: Powder Keg Round
fusions.desc: Fires a round that bursts on the first enemy in its path for 28 fire damage, 80% of that to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, and sets each [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Proof Load
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health: fires a double-charged round at an enemy up to 8 tiles away that deals 9 fire damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Slow Match
fusions.desc: Lays a line of burning powder 5 tiles long for 8 seconds. It deals 6 fire damage to anything crossing it and sets it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Cook-Off
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: you fire at the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 163% of your weapon damage. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
